description: A KPI card with an embedded sparkline trend for Power BI — show value, target, and history in one compact tile so the metric and its trajectory are visible at a glance. Codex KPI Sparkline Card extends the standard KPI tile with an inline trend line, giving viewers immediate context for whether a metric is improving, holding, or deteriorating. No separate chart needed. IDEAL FOR Operational dashboards where the trend matters as much as the value Multi-metric pages where space is at a premium but you need both number and direction Monitoring views where directional change is the headline (up is good or bad) Replacing two-visual layouts (KPI + chart) with one tile KEY FEATURES Sparkline overlay with configurable line and area styling Target comparison shown on the card as a variance, absolute or percentage, with its own positive and negative colours Last-point dot showing current value Optional category axis labels beneath the sparkline Full font controls on every text element Optional internal title with full font and alignment controls Hover tooltip showing value, target, and selected period Click to cross-filter other visuals Minimal modern design High contrast mode support PRO TIP Use a measure that returns the last 30 to 90 periods for the sparkline. Too few points and the trend feels jagged; too many and the sparkline becomes a blob. The right span depends on your business…
